| # Security access levels {#security-access-levels-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                 |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This topic explains the callbacks for the customer security levels.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Refer the below table for the callbacks to implement the seed and key algorithm with respect to the security levels.

- These security levels can be mapped with application defined parameters and access the permitted [UDS services](supported-uds-services.html){.topiclink}.

- For an overview of the Diagnostic Authentication concept, which includes security access levels, refer to the section titled [Diagnostic Authentication](diagnostic-authentication.html){.topiclink}.

- The Addition and deletion of the security levels is supported in the eC tool.

- By default only two customer levels are configured in the eC tool as a reference for the user to configure other required levels. Only 10 Levels can be configured in the eC tool by the user.

   i.e: Level 1 - 10 can be configured in the eC tool.

- If the BODAS Security Manager is selected for the security levels then the BSW will handle the seed and the key negotiation. The Size of the Seed and the Key is fixed to 16 bytes.

- The callbacks for the seed and the key for the security levels will be available only if the BODAS security manager is not selected in the eC tool.

   i.e: BODAS Security Manager is not selected.

- The Size of the Seed and the Key can be configured by the user in the eC tool only if the BODAS security manager is not selected in the eC tool.

- Delay time of 10 seconds is activated when a Wrong Key is entered or sent in Send Key Request. Tried to request for security access within this Delay time(i.e 10 seconds) negative response is sent from ECU with NRC 0x37.

- Three consecutive failure attempts of security access due to Wrong Key or Wrong Password security level is locked respectively.Requested for security level after security level is locked we get negative response with NRC 0x36.

- ECU will not accept the key for the seed request from the Tester for all security levels after the time period of 20 seconds and negative response is sent after the time period of 20 seconds from ECU with NRC 0x24.

Note: Refer bds_diag_appl_adapt.c for actual function prototypes.
